app.name: Custom card
app.summary: A card of values, rings, bars, tables and words that a template sensor in Home Assistant describes.
app.show_name_hint: The tile's name over its parts. Off: more room for the parts.
app.coloured_values_hint: The numbers take their part's colour, not only its icon, bar and ring.
app.per_row_hint: How the values and rings stand: as the tile's room makes them largest, all in one row, or two to a row.
app.values_hint: Without a template: pick up to six sensors, each shows its value, unit, name and icon. Left out when the tile's entity is a template sensor with elements.
app.traffic_lights_hint: Values 1 to 6: CO2, humidity and batteries in green, yellow or red.
